scientific_integrity: An invariant-column decomposition proves the cycle law over every finite field. First maximal-order jump populations are credited as group-level consequences, not a novel part of the claim.
scientific_limitations: Individual left-action cycles and fixed-point extrema only, not all Yang–Baxter orbits or the population of each cycle type across the brace. Priority comparison is bounded.
title: Individual left-action cycle types and sharp fixed-point bounds in triangular radical braces
